At some point between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[34 BBY/Legends|34 BBY]], [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]] forces under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of the [[Harch/Legends|Harch]] military leader [[Trench/Legends|Trench]] carried out a daring '''raid at Prospera Jang''', a celestial body<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Kurost sector/Legends|Kurost sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Prospera Jang system/Legends|Prospera Jang system]]</ref>
